summary: DeepSeek announced the general availability of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with agent-focused upgrades, flexible reasoning effort levels, native OpenAI Responses API support, and a new peak/off-peak API pricing structure taking effect August 16, 2026.

mechanisms.reason: DeepSeek introduced a tiered pricing scheme where off-peak inference is priced 50% below peak, lowering the effective cost of serving tokens during off-peak periods.
mechanisms.quote: Off-peak rates are 50% lower than peak, enabling more flexible workload scheduling.

mechanisms.reason: The release emphasizes major agent capability upgrades and Codex-optimized tool integration, signaling a push toward agentic, tool-using workloads.
mechanisms.quote: Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains! ... Native OpenAI Responses API support, optimized for Codex with one-click setup.

mechanisms.reason: Offering a 'max' reasoning effort tier for complex tasks implies higher per-query test-time compute consumption for some workloads.
mechanisms.quote: Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks.
